description: Ireland: tax on passing a farm by gift or inheritance, with and without the farm reliefs.

activeFarmer.description: Beneficiary will farm actively (qualification or 50% of working time) or lease to an active farmer for 6 years

baseCost.description: Gift only: CGT base cost of the farm (indexed for pre-2003 years), EUR

beneficiaryAssets.description: Beneficiary’s own gross assets before the transfer, EUR (for the 80% test)

date.description: Date of the gift or valuation date of the inheritance, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

disponerAge.description: Gift only: age of the person giving the farm

landValue.description: Farmland, buildings, machinery and livestock, EUR

otherValue.description: Non-farm assets in the same transfer, EUR

ownedAndUsed10Years.description: Gift only: owned and farmed (or let within the rules) for 10 years (default true)

priorBenefits.description: Earlier taxable gifts/inheritances in the same group since 5 Dec 1991, EUR

priorRelievedTransfers.description: Gift only: earlier relieved transfers (to children from 2025, or lifetime consideration to others), EUR

relationship.description: Who receives it: child (Group A), relative = brother, sister, nephew, niece, grandchild (Group B), other (Group C)

route.description: Gift during the owner’s lifetime or inheritance

youngTrainedFarmer.description: Gift only: transferee under 35 with a farming qualification and a Teagasc business plan

name: ireland_farm_transfer_tax
